claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The activation targets and persists on the carpet itself, not on the wielder or a creature. The current surface can attach direct effects to self, target, area, mark, or companion only.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: controlled_item_movement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet is a persistent non-creature object that gains flight and then moves repeatedly according to a controller's directions while within a control radius. The current surface only has controllable-creature support via companion payloads, which would be a false trace here.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_capacity_speed_modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's speed depends on carried load relative to its normal capacity. Existing speed atoms are creature-scoped and do not express load-threshold halving on an attached item/object.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.
